previous_statement: Kitaev application. For the arbitrary input of the root, the conclusions eta<1/4 and ||Phi^2-Phi||_cb<=eta permit application of lem-kitaev-almost-idemp-audit to the canonical tilde-Phi=(1/2)(I+(2Phi-I)(I-4(Phi-Phi^2))^(-1/2)), A=Im(tilde-Phi), and X star Y=tilde-Phi(XY), yielding tilde-Phi^2=tilde-Phi.
new_statement: Kitaev application. For an arbitrary input in the root domain, eta<=rho_id^corr<=rho_theta=1/8<1/4, while ||Phi^2-Phi||_cb<=eta is assumed. Therefore lem-kitaev-almost-idemp-audit applies to the canonical tilde-Phi=(1/2)(I+(2Phi-I)(I-4(Phi-Phi^2))^(-1/2)), A=Im(tilde-Phi), and X star Y=tilde-Phi(XY), and yields tilde-Phi^2=tilde-Phi.
